sources.title: GLM-5.2 & GLM-5.1 & GLM-5 - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLM-5.1 is our next-generation flagship model for agentic engineering, with significantly stronger coding capabilities than its predecessor. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench Pro and leads GLM-5 by a wide margin on NL2Repo (repo generation) and Terminal-Bench 2.0 (real-world terminal tasks).

sources.title: GLM model — GLM-5.2 benchmark test and 1M context guide
sources.snippet: A comprehensive comparison of each GLM model. GLM-5.2 achieves 81.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 74.4 on FrontierSWE, with a context of one million tokens — and also provides a free AI sandbox.

sources.title: GLM-5.2 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's new open model, delivering SOTA performance across long-horizon coding, reasoning, and agentic tasks. With 744B parameters, 40B active parameters, and a 1M context window, it can now be run locally using Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs.
